datasets.name: DSMain
datasets.sql:
SELECT a.rowid,a.id, a.type_id, a.begin_date, a.end_date,
        a.ammount,  a.policy_num, a.inssumm, a.franshiz,  a.reins,a.state,a.valute_id,a.ins_date,
        b.id as info_id, b.ins_type, b.custid, b.reins_part_komis, b.reins_ammount,
       b.reins_bruto_ammount, b.ins__pred_ammount, b.ins_id,b.cust_name,
       b.ins_ammount, b.ins_pred_info, b.cid,f.name,ii.name as sigorta_novu
FROM ins_contracts a,ins_rein_other_info b,filial f,ins_insurances ii
WHERE a.reins=1
and b.cid(+)=a.id
and f.id=a.filial
and ii.id=a.type_id

datasets.name: DSIns_cust
datasets.sql: select rowid,surname||' '||name||' '||fathername as name1,id from ins_customers where close_prefix=0 order by name1

datasets.name: DScutomers
datasets.sql:
select rowid,id ,name from customers
where close_dat is  null
and id in (SELECT cust_id  FROM ins_customers where close_prefix=0)

datasets.name: DSins_agents
datasets.sql: select rowid,id,surname||' '||name||' '||fathername as name from ins_agents

datasets.name: ODSAccount
datasets.sql:
SELECT   
   acc.RowID, ID, kli_id, op_id, acc_no, val_acc, NAME, open_dat, close_dat,
   DECODE (close_dat, NULL, 1, 2) AS status, bal_cn1, bal_cn2, bal_cn3,
   bal_cn4, filial, sim_otcet, tipacc, LIMIT, old_acc_no, pair_acc,
   insider, ownid, t.ostat, t.pok_ostat
FROM ACCOUNT  acc, tenostat t
where  t.acc_id = acc.id
and
 ownid = :ownid
and acc.close_dat is null
ORDER BY 
   id

datasets.name: dsins_type
